note: proofctl domain policy for the abc Conjecture Verification Kernel. Models domains/weil/policy-v2.json. Status is derived by proofctl; producer PASS flags are ignored. CL-12 (abc proved) and CL-13 (IUT verified) are both [OUT] and are never self-declared.
foundation_hash_note: SHA-256 of concatenated canonical texts of admitted BASE statements (CL-02, CL-05, CL-06) in claim-id order. Format: '<id>: <statement>\n' per line. Reproducible via checker/compute_foundation_hash.py. Originally frozen at P2 completion (2026-08-15); refrozen on 2026-08-17 after source-precise CL-02 wording.

module_import_policy.note: Non-anticipation barrier (spec §0.3). Construction modules must not import target/comparison/conclusion modules.

source_lock_hash_note: SHA-256 of M1 source files (proof/m1/*.py excluding __init__) in lexicographic order. Updated 2026-08-15 to include ob03_frey_framework.py (OB-03 independent review verified computations). Reproducible via checker/compute_source_lock_hash.py. Must be computed before any comparison/conclusion modules are admitted.

iut_policy.note: IUT-specific policy. Corollary 3.12 of IUTT-III must be independently machine-replayed. The Scholze-Stix dispute is recorded as a blocking obligation. This policy does not adjudicate the dispute.
iut_policy.blocking_reason: Scholze-Stix: identification of objects across Hodge theaters requires explicit isomorphism proof; not yet formalized
